items.description:

items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 2 to 4 feet above the normal high tide
line.

* WHERE...Yukon Delta Coast.

* WHEN...Until 1 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur. In Scammon Bay,
water may reach up to the boat launch.
